children: STOXX DIPS AS OIL, YIELDS RISE
European shares have begun their day in the red as oil prices and global bond yields have risen again following the recent exchange of attacks in the Middle East.

One bright spot is the energy sector (.SXEP), which is up over 1%, as oil and gas prices are rising for a second day on the escalation in the Middle East.
Travel & leisure (.SXTP) and defence stocks (.SXPARO) are Europe's biggest laggards.
